prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a low-speed head-on collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1135; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm has been retained to represent the interests of our client in connection with injuries sustained in the motor vehicle collision referenced above. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter, including any contact with our client, to this office and not to the client directly.

We request that you provide the bodily injury liability policy limits applicable to the at-fault driver, along with a copy of the declarations page for that policy. Please also confirm the identity of the adjuster assigned to this claim so that we may coordinate with them going forward.

Our client was involved in a low-speed head-on collision and has sustained injuries that are currently under medical evaluation. Any delay in responding may affect our client's ability to fully document the extent of these injuries and related losses.

We further request that your company preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes photographs, vehicle data and event data recorder information, telematics records, dashcam or surveillance footage, witness statements, recorded calls, claim notes, and all repair or total-loss documentation. Please ensure that none of this material is altered, repaired, or discarded while the claim is pending.
